In October of 2017 we spoke, most of all, of Las Vegas. 80 of us said "in las vegas"; 52 said "shooting in las vegas"; 49 said "mass shooting in." The peak fell on a single day, 2017-10-02.

Then we turned, together, to Iran. 48 of us said "the iran nuclear," and we reached for one instrument by its full name: 46 said "joint comprehensive plan of," 44 said "joint comprehensive plan of action," 44 said "the joint comprehensive plan of," and 42 said "the joint comprehensive plan of action." Each of these crested on the same later day, 2017-10-13.

Two shocks, two convergences, and in each we recorded ourselves in nearly the same words at nearly the same hour. That is the whole of what this era's record shows of us, and we will not add to it.
